target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product uses CRLF (carriage return line feeds) as a special element, e.g. to separate lines or records, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes CRLF sequences from inputs. Common in: input_validation.

Implement strict input validation with whitelisting
